```{ojs}
//| output: false
blue = "#0072B2"
orange = "#B55000"
ink = "#17202A"
muted = "#8A96A3"
shade = "#EEF1F4"
// Drawing units of a 257 mm wide slide area at 970 px: 24 px = 18 pt body text.
font = ({fontFamily: "'STIX Two Text', serif", fontSize: "19px", color: ink, background: "transparent"})
// One period −π ≤ x < π; the wavenumbers k are integers.
N = 1024
K = 256
xs = d3.range(N).map((i) => -Math.PI + (2 * Math.PI * i) / N)
// Cubic B-spline with knot spacing 1: piecewise cubic, C², peak 2/3.
bspline = (t) => {
  const a = Math.abs(t);
  return a < 1 ? 2 / 3 - a * a + a * a * a / 2 : a < 2 ? (2 - a) ** 3 / 6 : 0;
}
sinc = (u) => (u === 0 ? 1 : Math.sin(u) / u)
// Even profiles of peak 1 with their exact transforms F(k) = ∫ f(x) cos kx dx,
// so δB = a_0 + Σ a_k cos kx with a_0 = F(0)/2π, a_k = F(k)/π, free of sampling artefacts.
// Widths in multiples of π put the nodes of the sinc spectra on integer k.
sigma = 0.5
h = 0.2 * Math.PI
w = 0.4 * Math.PI
profiles = new Map([
  ["smooth (analytic)", {f: (x) => Math.exp(-0.5 * (x / sigma) ** 2),
    F: (k) => sigma * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI) * Math.exp(-0.5 * (k * sigma) ** 2),
    law: "∝ e<sup>−<i>k</i><sup>2</sup><i>σ</i><sup>2</sup>/2</sup>"}],
  ["cubic spline (C²)", {f: (x) => 1.5 * bspline(x / h),
    F: (k) => 1.5 * h * sinc(k * h / 2) ** 4, law: "∝ <i>k</i><sup>−4</sup>"}],
  ["kink (C⁰)", {f: (x) => Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(x) / w),
    F: (k) => w * sinc(k * w / 2) ** 2, law: "∝ <i>k</i><sup>−2</sup>"}],
  ["jump", {f: (x) => (Math.abs(x) < w ? 1 : Math.abs(x) === w ? 0.5 : 0),
    F: (k) => 2 * w * sinc(k * w), law: "∝ <i>k</i><sup>−1</sup>"}],
])
spectra = new Map([...profiles].map(([name, p]) => {
  const a = Float64Array.from(d3.range(K + 1), (k) => p.F(k) / (k === 0 ? 2 * Math.PI : Math.PI));
  return [name, {y: xs.map(p.f), a, law: p.law}];
}))
// Plain text with "10^-6" style exponents: draw them as superscripts.
superscripts = (svg) => {
  for (const t of svg.querySelectorAll("text")) {
    if (!t.textContent.includes("^")) continue;
    t.innerHTML = t.textContent.replace(/\^(\S+)/g, '<tspan baseline-shift="super" font-size="72%">$1</tspan>');
  }
  return svg;
}
// HTML label at drawing coordinates (x, y) of the W × H figure, so math is set
// with italic variables, sub- and superscripts in the slide font.
W = 970
H = 458
label = (x, y, content, {align = "start", color = ink, size = 0.8, back = false} = {}) => {
  const shift = {start: "0", middle: "-50%", end: "-100%"}[align];
  const el = htl.html`<div style="position:absolute; left:${(100 * x) / W}%; top:${(100 * y) / H}%;
    transform:translate(${shift}, -50%); white-space:nowrap; font-size:${size}rem; color:${color}; line-height:1;
    ${back ? "background:#fff; padding:0.1rem 0.2rem" : ""}">`;
  el.innerHTML = content;
  return el;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
s = spectra.get(shape)
kc = Math.round(kcut)
// Truncated series: keep wavenumbers k ≤ k_c.
yc = xs.map((x) => {
  let v = s.a[0];
  for (let k = 1; k <= kc; k++) v += s.a[k] * Math.cos(k * x);
  return v;
})
err = d3.max(xs, (_, i) => Math.abs(yc[i] - s.y[i]))
// Exact zeros of the spectrum (nodes of the sinc) are left out of the log plot.
amp = d3.range(1, K + 1).map((k) => ({k, c: Math.abs(s.a[k]), kept: k <= kc})).filter((d) => d.c > 1e-9)
real = xs.map((x, i) => ({x, y: s.y[i], yc: yc[i]}))
```

```{ojs}
{
  const left = 400;
  const spectrum = Plot.plot({
    width: left, height: H, marginLeft: 62, marginRight: 16, marginTop: 44, marginBottom: 56,
    style: font, clip: true,
    x: {type: "log", domain: [1, K], label: null, ticks: [1, 10, 100]},
    y: {type: "log", domain: [1e-6, 1], label: null, ticks: [1e-6, 1e-4, 1e-2, 1],
        tickFormat: (v) => `10^${Math.round(Math.log10(v))}`.replace("-", "−")},
    marks: [
      Plot.rect([0], {x1: 1, x2: kc, y1: 1e-6, y2: 1, fill: shade}),
      Plot.dot(amp, {x: "k", y: "c", r: 2.2, fill: (d) => (d.kept ? blue : muted), stroke: null}),
      Plot.ruleX([kc], {stroke: orange, strokeWidth: 2}),
    ],
  });
  const space = Plot.plot({
    width: W - left, height: H, marginLeft: 62, marginRight: 20, marginTop: 44, marginBottom: 56,
    style: font, clip: true,
    x: {domain: [-Math.PI, Math.PI], label: null, ticks: [-Math.PI, -Math.PI / 2, 0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI],
        tickFormat: (v) => ({"-2": "−π", "-1": "−π/2", "0": "0", "1": "π/2", "2": "π"})[Math.round((2 * v) / Math.PI)]},
    y: {domain: [-0.3, 1.3], label: null, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1]},
    marks: [
      Plot.line(real, {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: muted, strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "6,4"}),
      Plot.line(real, {x: "x", y: "yc", stroke: blue, strokeWidth: 2.5}),
      // Shortest kept wavelength 2π/k_c as a scale bar.
      Plot.ruleY([-0.17], {x1: -2.9, x2: -2.9 + (2 * Math.PI) / kc, stroke: orange, strokeWidth: 3}),
    ],
  });
  // The slide CSS stretches every plot to full width; keep the drawing proportions.
  spectrum.style.setProperty("width", `${(100 * left) / W}%`, "important");
  space.style.setProperty("width", `${(100 * (W - left)) / W}%`, "important");
  const sx = spectrum.scale("x").apply, sy = spectrum.scale("y").apply;
  const rx = space.scale("x").apply, ry = space.scale("y").apply;
  const kLabel = Math.min(sx(kc) + 8, sx(K) - 40);
  const barEnd = Math.min(rx(-2.9 + (2 * Math.PI) / kc) + 8, W - left - 90);
  return htl.html`<div style="position:relative; width:100%; aspect-ratio:${W}/${H}">
    <div style="display:flex; width:100%">${superscripts(spectrum)}${space}</div>
    ${label(6, 18, "|<i>a</i><sub><i>k</i></sub>| / δ<i>B</i><sub>max</sub> [1]")}
    ${label(62 + (left - 78) / 2, H - 16, "<i>k</i> [1]", {align: "middle"})}
    ${label((left + 90) / 2, 18, "δ<i>B</i> = <i>a</i><sub>0</sub> + Σ<sub><i>k</i></sub> <i>a</i><sub><i>k</i></sub> cos <i>kx</i>", {align: "middle"})}
    ${label(sx(K) - 4, sy(0.3), s.law, {align: "end", back: true})}
    ${label(kLabel, sy(2e-6), "<i>k</i><sub>c</sub>", {color: orange})}
    ${label(left + 6, 18, "δ<i>B</i> / δ<i>B</i><sub>max</sub> [1]")}
    ${label(left + 62 + (W - left - 82) / 2, H - 16, "<i>x</i> [1]", {align: "middle"})}
    ${label(left + barEnd, ry(-0.17), "2π / <i>k</i><sub>c</sub>", {color: orange})}
  </div>`;
}
```

<div class="readout" id="err"></div>

```{ojs}
//| output: false
document.getElementById("err").innerHTML = `max |δ<i>B</i> − δ<i>B</i><sub>c</sub>| / δ<i>B</i><sub>max</sub> = ${err.toFixed(err < 0.01 ? 4 : 2)}`
```

```{ojs}
viewof shape = Inputs.radio([...profiles.keys()], {value: "jump", label: "profile"})
viewof kcut = Inputs.range([2, K], {value: 8, transform: Math.log, step: 1,
  label: html`<i>k</i><sub>c</sub>`})
```

```{ojs}
{
  const div = viewof kcut.querySelector("div");

}
```
